senses.sense_definition: Technology, especially information technology, used to support or enable banking and financial services.

examples.text: The rapid growth of <w>fintech</w> is changing how people manage their personal savings and investments.

target_lang_translations.zh: <w>金融科技</w>的快速发展正在改变人们管理个人储蓄和投资的方式。

examples.text: Many traditional banks are now investing heavily in <w>fintech</w> to improve their digital services.

target_lang_translations.zh: 许多传统银行现在正大力投资<w>金融科技</w>，以改善其数字服务。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 用于支持或实现银行及金融服务的技术，特别是信息技术。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代金融与技术结合的领域或技术本身

senses.sense_definition: A company that uses technology to provide financial services such as payments, loans, or fundraising.

examples.text: The new <w>fintech</w> offers a mobile app that makes international money transfers much cheaper.

target_lang_translations.zh: 这家新的<w>金融科技公司</w>提供了一款移动应用程序，使国际汇款变得便宜得多。

examples.text: Investors are looking for the next successful <w>fintech</w> to support with venture capital.

target_lang_translations.zh: 投资者们正在寻找下一家值得用风险资本支持的成功<w>金融科技公司</w>。

target_lang_definitions.zh: 利用技术提供支付、贷款或筹款等金融服务的公司。

zh.target_lang_sense_clarification: 指代从事金融科技业务的企业
